title: SACA: Selective Attention-Based Clustering Algorithm
abstract: arXiv:2508.17150v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Clustering algorithms are fundamental tools across many fields, with density-based methods offering particular advantages in identifying arbitrarily shaped clusters and handling noise. However, their effectiveness is often limited by the requirement of critical parameter tuning by users, which typically requires significant domain expertise. This paper introduces a novel density-based clustering algorithm loosely inspired by the concept of selective attention, designed to minimize reliance on parameter tuning for most applications. The proposed method computes an adaptive threshold to exclude sparsely distributed points and outliers, constructs an initial cluster framework, and subsequently reintegrates the filtered points to refine the final results. translated_title: SACA：基于选择性注意力的聚类算法
translated_abstract: 聚类算法是许多领域的基础工具，其中基于密度的方法在识别任意形状的簇和处理噪声方面具有独特优势。然而，此类方法的有效性常常受限于用户需要进行关键参数调优，而这通常要求具备大量的领域专业知识。本文提出了一种新颖的基于密度的聚类算法，其设计灵感松散地来源于选择性注意力的概念，旨在最大限度地减少大多数应用场景中对参数调优的依赖。该方法通过计算自适应阈值来排除稀疏分布的点和异常值，构建初始聚类框架，随后将先前过滤掉的点重新整合，以完善最终的聚类结果。在多种基准数据集上进行的广泛实验证明了所提方法的鲁棒性、准确性和易用性，使其成为传统密度聚类方法的有力替代方案。
tldr: 本文提出了一种受选择性注意力概念启发的新型密度聚类算法SACA，通过自适应阈值自动过滤噪声点和异常值并重新整合优化结果，大幅降低了传统密度聚类方法对参数调优的依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SACA, a novel density-based clustering algorithm inspired by selective attention, which uses adaptive thresholds to automatically filter sparse points and outliers and reintegrate them for refinement, greatly reducing the reliance on manual parameter tuning.
